feature: Announced X where a fixed number is required
description: Let selectors, searches, look-at and mill counts, untap limits, counter removal and copy counts take the announced X or another computed Value (mana value X or less, greatest power among attackers, mana spent, commander mana value, Shrines controlled, colors spent, dice totals).

feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events and filters for dice rolls, scrying, investigating, cycling, room unlocks, lands entering from non-hand zones, cards going to a graveyard from a library, exact-amount damage, damage from Warrior sources, equipped creature activations, and additional trigger instances.

feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Add selector predicates for distinct names, opponent-only player targets, keyword cards in libraries, creatures damaged by this source, controlled-by-target-player groups, attacking-when-died, planeswalker attackers, equipped-by-you, equipped creature power, and shared creature types or colorless sources.

feature: Conditional rule statics and permissions
description: Add rule statics for cast-timing limits, draw limits, untap limits, damage assignment by toughness, max-blockers, extra-turn attack bans, opponent-only sacrifice protection, extra costs for targeting, creature-spell-only casting limits, and permanent hand-size changes.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add entry options for returned and put-onto-battlefield cards (tapped, attacking, attached to a chosen object, gaining haste and a sacrifice rider, under the owner's control).

feature: Amounts produced by the previous effect or event
description: Add Values for hand size, cards discarded this turn, amass results, cards in a targeted player's graveyard, opponents with more lands, creatures with different powers, attackers, mana value of a returned card, and cards exiled by an earlier effect.

feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player-scope and chooser fields so hand-to-battlefield, search, sacrifice, gain-control, extra-turn and shuffle effects can address each player, each opponent or the event player separately.

feature: Missing keyword mechanics (delve, echo, myriad, decayed, splice)
description: Add keywords the schema lacks or cannot grant: partner, myriad, mobilize with sacrifice, fear, exert, convoke grants, cumulative upkeep by sacrifice, and umbra armor.

feature: Counterspell variants
description: Let counter effects act on the countered spell's controller, the triggering spell or ability, and every spell, add follow-ups after the payment, exile instead of graveyard, and name the targeted creature's controller as payer.

feature: Granted statics and characteristic-setting effects
description: Add effects that grant static abilities, emblems with statics, all creature types, additional types and colors, token can't-block flags, group becomes-creature effects, and control-change statics.

feature: Modern keyword actions (venture, ring tempts, suspect, crime)
description: Add effects for the Ring tempting you, earthbend, taking the initiative, rolling the planar die, connive on a target, and stun-counter untap replacement.

feature: Alternative-cost keyword mechanics
description: Model overload, encore, suspend, madness, flashback, harmonize, warp and return-permanent alternative costs as alternative casts or costs.

feature: Ability cost forms
description: Add cost components and alternatives (return a land or permanent to hand, return-or-sacrifice choices, discard filtered by type, sacrifice two untapped lands) and cost reductions for abilities.

feature: Token copy color, type and cost overrides
description: Let token copies and becomes-a-copy effects carry overrides: replaced colors and types, copy-as-enters-tapped, copy chosen from graveyards, each-permanent copy, per-creature copies of a chosen type, and tap-and-freeze riders.

feature: Library and graveyard repositioning
description: Add exile-whole-library, shuffle-target-into-library, bottom-of-library-then-reveal, split top-and-bottom placement, optional graveyard rest, and opponent-library reveal-until-lands effects.

feature: Reveal/exile/mill-until loops with leftovers handling
description: Add reveal-until, exile-until-lesser-mana-value, exile-until-total-mana-value and reveal-then-draw-if loops, with free-cast and destination handling for the leftovers.

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add free or alternative casting of cards from graveyards and exile, foraging costs, granted activated abilities, mana-of-any-type permissions and exile-if-countered riders.

feature: Reference to the card moved by the previous effect
description: Let follow-up effects, reflexive triggers and delayed effects refer to the token, creature or card the previous effect created or moved (tokens just created, crewing creatures, cards exiled with this permanent, the blocked creature, the sacrificed creature).

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Add any-number, announced-count, up-to-one and per-opponent target slots, including graveyard returns and destroy-then-token follow-ups.

feature: Turn-history conditions
description: Add conditions for what happened this turn (counter put on a creature, life gained, creatures that died under your control) and for opponents' poison counters and the controller's hand size.

feature: Mana production and spending restrictions
description: Add mana production for a targeted or event player, mana counts per artifact, and mana spending restrictions limited to X costs or spell kinds.

feature: Damage prevention and replacement variants
description: Add prevention of noncombat damage to you and your creatures, damage tripling, unpreventable damage, and damage from a chosen source such as the equipped creature.

feature: Sacrificed cost object's power/mana value
description: Add Values that read the toughness or mana value of an object sacrificed as a cost or effect.

feature: Unrecognized ability-word lines the patch cannot replace
description: The patch can only append triggers, so an ability-word line already parsed into a flagged trigger cannot be replaced.

feature: one-off
description: Lines needing a bespoke mechanic found on a single card.
